annotation.title_clean: La Commission publie des lignes directrices sur la définition des systèmes d’IA afin de faciliter l’application des règles de la première législation sur l’IA
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on AI system definition to facilitate application of the first AI Act rules
annotation.venue: Bâtir l’avenir numérique de l’Europe (Digital Strategy, European Commission)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing non-binding guidelines on the AI system definition under the EU AI Act, published 6 February 2025 alongside prohibited-practices guidelines. Helps providers determine whether a software system is an AI system. Lists downloads in all EU languages.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines clarify the practical application of the AI system definition in the AI Act
Guidelines are non-binding and will be updated based on practical experience
Published alongside guidelines on prohibited AI practices
First AI Act rules, including definition, AI literacy and prohibitions, applied from 2 February 2025
